message.content: Of the 56 people who signed the Declaration of Independence, excluding any future presidents and anyone born outside of the US, which of them actually died before American independence was officially won?

input.query: signers Declaration of Independence died before 1783 American independence won born in colonies not future presidents

Based on the National Archives data for all 56 signers, I filtered for those who: (1) were not future presidents (excluding John Adams and Thomas Jefferson), (2) were born in the American colonies (excluding 8 born in England, Wales, Scotland, or Ireland), and (3) died before the Treaty of Paris was signed on September 3, 1783 (the official end of the war and recognition of independence).

**7 signers meet all criteria:**

| Signer | State | Birthplace | Date of Death |
|--------|-------|------------|---------------|
| John Hart | NJ | Hunterdon Co., NJ | 5/11/1779 |
| Joseph Hewes | NC | Kingston, NJ | 10/10/1779 |
| Philip Livingston | NY | Albany, NY | 6/12/1778 |
| Thomas Lynch Jr. | SC | Prince George's Parish, SC | c. 1779 |
| John Morton | PA | Ridley Township, PA | c. 1777 |
| George Ross | PA | New Castle, DE | 7/14/1779 |
| Richard Stockton | NJ | Princeton, NJ | 2/28/1781 |

All seven were born in the colonies, none became president, and all died during the Revolutionary War—before independence was formally secured by treaty in 1783.
